_comment: npm audit allow-list for the release gate (Sprint v3 Task 36). Only these packages may carry an unresolved high/critical advisory. Each entry needs a reason and a review date; anything else fails the release. All three are local build/QA tooling with no exposure to untrusted public input (sprints/v2/WALKTHROUGH.md §14, sprints/v2/TASKS.md Task 18).

allow.reason: Fix (0.35.4) is a breaking major used by 8 normalisation scripts; deferred by the user in Sprint v2 Task 18. Runs only at build time on trusted local artwork.
Advisory concerns browser download over TLS without certificate verification; the fix (1.63.0) is outside the pinned range and needs a new Chromium download. Test/QA tooling only.
No fixed version on the public npm registry (SheetJS). Reads only the editor's own tracker workbook at build time.
